message.content: {"count":2,"rationale":"Deploy mfa:admin and mfa:dbadmin together. The first blocks authentication to DC and ADFS, preventing admin_dc and admin_adfs. The second then blocks authentication to DB, fileserver, and backup even if CI leaks stolen_dbadmin. Thus no exfiltration technique can become enabled. No single control suffices: mfa:admin alone leaves the CI secret-leak route open; mfa:dbadmin alone can be bypassed through DC or ADFS administration. Any other single control leaves the DC/ADFS route open: phishing supplies user credentials and bypasses user MFA, Kerberoasting supplies admin credentials, and segmentation alone is bypassed by escalating an unpatched workstation or laptop."}
